title: gpt-loop wake event
description: POSTed by the GitHub Actions runner to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/event only for packet-terminal outcomes. Delivery is exactly-once from the user's perspective: an event is consumed only after the extension observes its marker in a ChatGPT user message. `continuation` and `quota_wait` are intentionally absent because they must not wake the conversation.

event_id.description: Stable delivery identity, '<run_id>:<run_attempt>:<issue_number>'. Re-POSTing the same id is a no-op, which is what makes duplicate notifications harmless.

deliveryState.description: Server-side lifecycle. Only `acknowledged` is terminal; anything short of it is retried after a restart, because an unproven delivery must never be treated as done.

wakeMarker.description: What the extension types into the conversation. The bracketed marker is the unique substring the verifier looks for.
